gen-eater-gf-readex-pro: Eater growls in thin, wide-spaced strokes with short ascenders. Readex Pro follows in a plain sans, its weight holding steady from word to word, so a long page goes down smoothly without any fuss.
gen-flavors-gf-roboto: Stubby, towering lowercase and diagonals as heavy as the stems make Flavors feel like a carnival sign. And Roboto, sans-serif with generous round mouths, keeps a long stretch of text moving with a low-key, contemporary ease.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-ruda: Autour One draws bold, expressive letters with a clear channel into each round shape and almost no step from caps down to lowercase. Ruda, a plain sans, reads softly.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-elymai: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, with a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut. Noto Sans Elymaic, a plain sans, simply does the quiet work of clear, open text.
gen-audiowide-gf-sofia-sans: Sofia Sans is sans-serif with no thick-thin modulation and open-sided rounds, standing tall like cut acrylic. And Audiowide sets its futuristic tiles beside it, so a long passage keeps a crisp, modern flow.
gen-flavors-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Schibsted Grotesk is sans-serif with big, open-looking e and a shapes and terminals that never close in. And Flavors gives it a foil, its flat, sign-painter's-stencil line weight making the whole pairing feel playful yet commanding.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-sarpanch: Sarpanch is sans-serif with a clearly open lowercase e and a compact gap up to its ascender line. And Autour One brings diagonals as thick as its uprights, which is where this pair feels boldest.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-georgi: Almendra Display brings an ornate, literary look, with a pronounced x-height and letters that never pinch shut. Noto Sans Georgian is a clean, open sans whose size you can raise a notch for comfort.
gen-eater-gf-sen: Sen is a modern plain sans built tall, tracing each letter with a line of constant weight and no stroke contrast at all. Eater, meanwhile, goes dark and aggressive.
gen-flavors-gf-sintony: Whimsical and a bit chunky, with a towering x-height up top. And Sintony, sans-serif with a tall midzone and smooth, unclogged curves, is what makes the pair strongest: a heading that shouts and a body that reads clean.
